rows.name: resource
rows.text: A resource is a named quantity at a named ownership boundary; its unit fixes how that quantity is counted.
rows.title: Resource

rows.name: bound
rows.text: A bound is a proved or declared maximum on an object or operation, with its evidence class stated.
rows.title: Bound

rows.name: limit
rows.text: A limit is a restriction on a declared resource or operation; a ceiling is its finite admitted policy maximum. An absent or unlimited setting supplies no finite ceiling or containment. Zero retains the owning contract’s meaning, not an inferred unlimited sentinel.
rows.title: Limit

rows.name: allowance
rows.text: An allowance is permission available to one scope under its ceiling.
rows.title: Allowance

rows.name: budget
rows.text: A budget groups allowances and their admission rules; it is not a common resource unit.
rows.title: Budget

rows.name: envelope
rows.text: An envelope is a collection of bounds describing a stated operating scope, not a conversion between their units.
rows.title: Envelope

rows.name: admission
rows.text: Admission checks and commits permission before the covered action.
rows.title: Admission

rows.name: charge
rows.text: A charge records permission consumed under the owner’s declared rule.
rows.title: Charge

rows.name: reservation
rows.text: A reservation holds permission for a bounded future action or live capacity until it is consumed or released.
rows.title: Reservation

rows.name: meter
rows.text: A meter enforces an admission and charging rule; usage is its receipt.
rows.title: Meter

rows.name: cost
rows.text: A cost is measured or derived expenditure under a named scope, not a synonym for a ceiling or a promise of completion.
rows.title: Cost

rows.name: usage-views
rows.text: Occupancy describes currently held capacity, cumulative traffic records requests or consumption over a declared scope, and high-water usage records a historical maximum. These views are not interchangeable totals.
rows.title: Usage views
